summary: The 21 unanchored canon/mixed episodes inside 262-298 adapt chs 517-550 (v55-58), the Fourth Shinobi World War: Confrontation arc, with three filler blocks interleaved (271, 279-281, 284-295). Narutopedia episode-infobox chapter fields and animefillerguide's chapter table agree exactly on every episode, and Wikipedia's volume 55-58 chapter titles independently corroborate eight boundaries by title match (527 Forbidden Words=ep269, 529 Golden Bonds=ep270, 532 Mifune vs. Hanzo Decided=ep272, 534 Farewell Ino-Shika-Cho=ep274, 542 Ultimate Tag Team=ep282, 544 Two Suns=ep283, 548 Naruto vs. Itachi=ep298, plus 520 Edotensei secrets=ep264). The zone is a war-rotation adaptation: multi-front chapters are split per battlefield, so consecutive episodes share one to two boundary chapters throughout (most sharply 272/273, which divide chs 530-532 into the Mifune-vs-Hanzo thread and the Team-Asuma-vs-Kakuzu/Asuma thread). Both endpoints lock onto existing anchors with no contradiction: ep261 END 516 precedes ep262's 517 start, and ep298's END 550 hands off to the stored ep299 = 551-552 (the stored ep300 ch-548 sliver matches afg's ep-300 row). Mixed ep296 is canon only from ~06:31 per afg (chs 545-546); no repairs and no type corrections needed.

structure.notes: Single 500-episode run, cumulative numbering = broadcast numbering (no conversion needed; afg per-season indices in parentheses map trivially). The 262-298 gap is the Fourth Shinobi World War: Confrontation arc adapting chs 517-550 across v55-58, interrupted by filler at 271, 279-281 and 284-295 (all N/A in afg, matching our stored types — no type corrections). Both zone endpoints reconcile exactly with stored anchors: ep261 END 516 (afg row 261 = 515-516) precedes ep262's start 517, and ep298 END 550 precedes the stored ep299 = 551-552; afg's ep-300 row (548, 552-556) matches the stored ch-548-sliver annotation. Volume edges land exactly on episode boundaries three times: ep266 closes v55 (524), ep274 closes v56 (534), ep283 closes v57 (544).
